major_cooldowns.name: Tiger's Fury
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown to maximize energy generation and snapshot your bleeds.

major_cooldowns.name: Berserk
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use synced with Convoke the Spirits and Tiger's Fury for massive burst windows.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use alongside Berserk to rapid-fire abilities and finishers.

major_cooldowns.name: Feral Frenzy
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use as a combo point generator when low on combo points, ideally with Tiger's Fury active.

defensives.name: Survival Instincts
defensives.usage_rule: Use to survive massive predictable bursts of damage.

defensives.name: Barkskin
defensives.usage_rule: Use frequently on incoming moderate damage or while stunned.

defensives.name: Renewal
defensives.usage_rule: Use for a massive instant self-heal when dropping low.

rules.action: Always pair Berserk and Convoke the Spirits together for burst phases.
Ensure Tiger's Fury is active before pressing Berserk or Convoke.
Apply or refresh Rip when Tiger's Fury is active and you have 5 combo points.
Dump your energy if Tiger's Fury is coming off cooldown within 3 seconds to avoid overcapping.

source_summary: Feral Druid relies heavily on 'snapshotting' its bleeds (Rip, Rake) with Tiger's Fury. Its burst potential is unlocked by precisely aligning Berserk, Convoke the Spirits, and Tiger's Fury into a massive overlapping window.
